names.legendary: Wickermaw, Keeper of Lost Picnics

lore.common: Squeaks its handle at anyone who tries to carry fewer than three sandwiches.
lore.uncommon: Fits one more item than physics should permit. Hates being asked where it goes.
lore.rare: Swallowed a week's laundry and returned every sock except the one you actually needed.
lore.epic: Rolled down the hill carrying a full picnic and came back with three extra pies and a bewildered goose.
lore.legendary: Inside its woven belly lie all the picnics ever interrupted by rain. The oldest sandwich is worshipped by a very small mouse civilization.

names.legendary: Cartonax, the Kingdom Within a Box

lore.common: Hides the end of its packing tape so effectively that even the tape forgets where it is.
lore.uncommon: Transforms into a luxury mansion for the cat the second the expensive gift is removed.
lore.rare: Swallows the contents of every box stacked above it. The movers blame each other.
lore.epic: Folded a moving van flat with the furniture still inside. The removal team put the result in the recycling and called it minimalism.
lore.legendary: Cartonax holds an entire world behind its four ordinary flaps. The inhabitants worship a child who occasionally opens the sky and drops in packing peanuts.

names.legendary: Cratescar, Keeper of Lost Voyages

lore.common: Gives everyone a splinter. Calls it a souvenir.
lore.uncommon: Pretends to be empty until someone lifts it and hears suspicious giggling.
lore.rare: Grows extra wooden slats whenever a smuggler approaches. Tax inspectors adore it.
lore.epic: Stacked itself into a walking fortress and marched through the wholesale market demanding to speak with the manager.
lore.legendary: Has sailed on every trading ship ever lost at sea. Its wooden walls contain a map to a hundred forgotten ports and at least one extremely annoyed dockworker.

names.legendary: Madame Clasp, Keeper of Lost Tuesdays

lore.common: Hides the keys beneath seventeen receipts and a mysterious ancient mint.
lore.uncommon: Has a secret pocket that only opens after the owner has bought replacement keys.
lore.rare: Swallows a whole umbrella without becoming any larger. The umbrella has started sending postcards.
lore.epic: Burst open on the royal steps and scattered a thousand forgotten possessions. The king recognised his own missing crown.
lore.legendary: Madame Clasp carries every object ever misplaced by her family. The bottom of her bag opens onto a vast city where lost gloves run the government.

names.legendary: Claspador, Oathkeeper of the Last Notch

lore.common: Pinches skin just as the wearer says it fits perfectly. It has a talent for contradiction.
lore.uncommon: Gleams in the sunlight like buried treasure. Pirates have stopped three people in the street to ask.
lore.rare: Finds one more hole in a belt whenever a feast runs late. The tailor suspects witchcraft.
lore.epic: Locked every belt at the royal banquet one notch tighter just before dessert. The king declared war on the pudding.
lore.legendary: Claspador once held a knight's armour together through the storm of a hundred dragons. The knight still credits his sword; Claspador has never forgiven him.

names.legendary: Sirenette, the Unlosable Slide

lore.common: Escapes a perfect hairstyle before morning break and turns up in the school lunchbox.
lore.uncommon: Sheds enough glitter on the pillow to convince the family that fairies have moved in.
lore.rare: Holds a hundred runaway curls in formation during the fiercest wind on the playground.
lore.epic: Pinned the stage curtains together during the school musical. The actors improvised an entire opera from behind them.
lore.legendary: Sirenette was gifted to a mountain queen whose hair flowed like a waterfall. One tiny slide held back the torrent and saved her village from a very fashionable flood.

names.legendary: Lord Crinkletop of the Never-Empty Bag

lore.common: Tears straight down the middle, even when the packet has a helpful little arrow.
lore.uncommon: Crinkles in the quietest cinema scene and waits for everyone to turn around.
lore.rare: Reseals itself around the last biscuit and demands the secret password.
lore.epic: Burst at the school assembly and filled the hall with a hurricane of crisps. Even the head teacher left with a salty collar.
lore.legendary: Lord Crinkletop carried provisions across a hundred deserts without ever running empty. Explorers celebrated his generosity until they learned the bag contained only cheese-flavoured air.

names.legendary: Postmaster Redgrave, Keeper of Goodbyes

lore.common: Bites the corner off every envelope that is slightly too fat for the slot.
lore.uncommon: Swallows a parcel labelled FRAGILE with surprising confidence and a metallic burp.
lore.rare: Sorts lost letters by the secrets written inside them, delivering apologies before anyone has worked up the nerve to send them.
lore.epic: Opened at midnight and released a whirlwind of forgotten birthday cards across the city. Everyone woke up inexplicably celebrated.
lore.legendary: Postmaster Redgrave has carried letters across centuries without losing a name. It is said his deepest compartment contains the reply to every farewell that never received one.

names.legendary: Count Scentula, Prince of Eternal Musk

lore.common: Sprays once and makes an entire bus smell like a pine tree trying too hard.
lore.uncommon: Adds another spray whenever somebody says it's a bit strong. Nobody says it twice.
lore.rare: Can leave its scent in a room three days before arriving. The witnesses are confused.
lore.epic: Uncorked itself at the royal gala and turned the entire ballroom into a fog of sandalwood. Guests recognised one another by coughing patterns.
lore.legendary: Count Scentula wears a fragrance distilled from midnight roses and aristocratic arrogance. His perfume has inspired fourteen love letters, three lawsuits and a formal complaint from the forest.

names.legendary: Madame Nocturne of the Thousand Roses

lore.common: Shoots one puff straight into the nose of anyone who says it smells too strong.
lore.uncommon: Fills a whole room with a garden's worth of roses. The bees keep knocking on the window.
lore.rare: Makes strangers remember summers they have never lived. Grandad now claims to have sailed with pirates.
lore.epic: Escaped a department-store shelf and perfumed the entire city with the smell of freshly baked bread. The bakeries were mobbed by noon.
lore.legendary: Madame Nocturne distilled the scent of a vanished rose garden into a single drop. On the darkest winter night, it blooms around anyone who has forgotten what spring feels like.

names.legendary: Portmanteus, the Unlost Traveller

lore.common: Has one wheel with very strong opinions about which direction is forward.
lore.uncommon: Swallows one holiday sock and produces a hotel soap from 2004.
lore.rare: Steps off the baggage carousel by itself and checks into the best hotel in town.
lore.epic: Unzipped at the airport and disgorged a travelling circus, complete with an elephant demanding window seats.
lore.legendary: Portmanteus contains every road its owners have ever travelled. Open the right compartment and you can walk back to a childhood holiday for one perfect afternoon.

names.legendary: Ironmaw, Captain of the False Gold

lore.common: Snaps its lid when anybody tries to peek. The coins inside applaud.
lore.uncommon: Rattles with treasure until opened, then reveals fourteen buttons and a suspicious spoon.
lore.rare: Swallows lockpicks and spits out tiny brass keys. None opens the chest.
lore.epic: Rose from the ocean floor carrying a pirate fleet's entire fortune. Every captain claimed ownership, so it swallowed their maps and left.
lore.legendary: Ironmaw guards a treasure that makes its finder the richest soul alive. Nobody knows what it is, because every pirate who opens the lid finds a mirror and immediately gets very offended.

names.legendary: Lord Leatherton, the Unspent Fortune

lore.common: Drops exactly one coin under the supermarket till.
lore.uncommon: Keeps every expired receipt but mysteriously loses the important one.
lore.rare: Opens a hidden pocket whenever its owner is certain the money has vanished.
lore.epic: Exploded into an avalanche of loyalty cards at the busiest checkout in the city. The cashier discovered membership to a club for retired dragons.
lore.legendary: Carried a pauper's last copper through a thousand generous hands. By the time it returned, the copper had bought a school, a bakery and one enormous thank-you cake.

names.legendary: Ankharp, the Silver Song of the Sea

lore.common: Jingles whenever its wearer tries to sneak somewhere. Thinks stealth is an insult to its talent.
lore.uncommon: Tangles itself around shoelaces and blames the sandals. It has an excellent lawyer and a terrible reputation.
lore.rare: Its tiny charms ring out when treasure lies buried nearby. Unfortunately, it considers bottle caps treasure.
lore.epic: Danced along the pier and drew a hundred gulls into a silver cyclone. Nobody knows where the fish and chips went, but the gulls look satisfied.
lore.legendary: Ankharp's bells sing to the ocean itself. At its call, tides retreat to reveal long-lost paths, then return with a thousand tiny shells as payment.

names.legendary: Awnaris, Canopy of the Thousand Suns

lore.common: Waits for somebody to walk below, then drops an entire puddle down their collar. Calls it a weather report.
lore.uncommon: Casts shade exactly one inch away from where everyone is sitting. The cafe regulars have begun negotiating with it.
lore.rare: Can unfurl across a street in one blink, sheltering everyone except the person who forgot their umbrella.
lore.epic: Caught a summer thunderstorm in its striped canvas and rolled it up like a carpet. The cafe owner accidentally released it during the lunch rush.
lore.legendary: Awnaris spreads its vast canopy over cities threatened by endless sun. Under its shadow crops flourish, travellers rest, and one determined pigeon insists the whole thing belongs to him.

names.legendary: Chancellor Vox, Keeper of the Final Vote

lore.common: Swallows paper slips and gives suspicious little burps whenever someone says recount.
lore.uncommon: Counts votes perfectly, but refuses to reveal the result until everyone has finished their biscuits.
lore.rare: Once elected the classroom hamster as headteacher. Its first decree was mandatory naps.
lore.epic: Organised an election for king of the playground. The slide won with 98 percent; the swing demanded an audit.
lore.legendary: Has presided over a thousand kingdoms. Every ruler eventually discovers that Vox's own vote simply reads NO CONFIDENCE.

names.legendary: Parasolia, Keeper of the Last Shade

lore.common: Falls over exactly when somebody is carrying ice cream. The timing is an art.
lore.uncommon: Casts shade over one person and makes everyone else negotiate for elbow space.
lore.rare: Rides gusts of wind across crowded beaches, scattering sandwiches like festive confetti.
lore.epic: Opened wide enough to cast an entire seaside town into shadow. The sunbathers immediately formed a protest group.
lore.legendary: The last shade in the desert follows Parasolia wherever she walks. Even the Sun sends polite requests for permission to shine.

names.legendary: Perloria, Queen of the Broken Necklace

lore.common: Falls off the table and rolls into a place no vacuum cleaner has ever reached.
lore.uncommon: Escapes the necklace precisely one bead before the knot is tied. Laughs without making a sound.
lore.rare: Can split white sunlight into colours and embroider a rainbow across any room.
lore.epic: Burst from a craft jar in a million glittering copies. The entire school hall became a rolling maze of tiny treasures.
lore.legendary: Every lost bead finds its way to Perloria beneath the floorboards. She wears the world's forgotten necklaces as a crown of impossible colours.

names.legendary: Duke Pockethold, Master of Hidden Paths

lore.common: Bounces against your hip on every step. Develops a rhythm entirely unrelated to walking.
lore.uncommon: Hides snacks behind a zipper that appears only when nobody is hungry.
lore.rare: Can hold a map, compass and whole hiking lunch without feeling heavier. Steals the biscuits as payment.
lore.epic: Clipped itself around the village fair and swallowed the entire bouncy castle. The children asked whether it came in blue.
lore.legendary: Worn by the first mountain goat to cross the high peaks, this enchanted pouch contains every trail that has ever vanished in mist.

names.legendary: Obento, Keeper of the Perfect Meal

lore.common: Lets one rice grain escape into the fruit section, then acts terribly shocked.
lore.uncommon: Forbids peas and custard from occupying the same compartment. The treaty is binding.
lore.rare: Arranges lunch into tiny edible animals that judge the eater for disturbing the scenery.
lore.epic: Declared every school lunch a miniature kingdom. The carrot samurai and rice ninjas fought over the last cherry tomato.
lore.legendary: In her lacquered palace, a thousand perfect dishes remain forever separate. Even the gods cannot persuade her to let the sauce touch the rice.

names.legendary: Aurelia, Warden of the Silver Promise

lore.common: Jangles against every desk in the house while its owner is trying to write quietly.
lore.uncommon: Slides down the arm whenever someone waves. It has nearly shaken hands with the floor.
lore.rare: Steals charms from other bracelets and hides them in its links. Every charm has an alibi.
lore.epic: Snagged one corner of the banquet tablecloth and pulled an entire royal feast into a very surprised musician's lap.
lore.legendary: Each of Aurelia's silver links holds a promise once made and forgotten. When she rings her charms, the promise-maker remembers, usually at an inconvenient moment.

names.legendary: Lady Cameora, Jewel of the Lost Fleet

lore.common: Gets pinned on at a slight angle and makes everybody tilt their head to speak politely.
lore.uncommon: Gleams so brightly from a coat lapel that strangers ask to see the owner's entire life story.
lore.rare: Jumps from jacket to jacket at formal parties. Has attended nine weddings without an invitation.
lore.epic: Flashed during the royal ball and sent the entire waltz turning backward. The orchestra reversed the music rather than argue.
lore.legendary: Cameora was once a star captured in a jewelled pin. A sailor wore her through seven storms, and she still remembers every wave by name.

names.legendary: Pouchorius, Emperor of the Unfashionable

lore.common: Slides from hip to belly whenever someone starts dancing. It likes a front-row view.
lore.uncommon: Knocks its zip against every railing on a walk and calls the noise percussion.
lore.rare: Swaps snacks with random strangers' pockets. Dad once paid for a sandwich with a dog biscuit.
lore.epic: Sprang open on the roller coaster and launched enough sun cream to repaint the entire queue. The park called it complimentary moisturiser.
lore.legendary: Pouchorius ruled fashion for one glorious decade before being banished to the souvenir shop. Every thirty years he returns, and somehow everyone calls it retro.

names.legendary: Lord Fourholes, Guardian of Last Thread

lore.common: Escapes your shirt during important meetings. It always lands beneath the boss's chair.
lore.uncommon: Sneaks into the wrong buttonhole and makes the entire coat look drunk.
lore.rare: Undoes itself whenever its wearer lies. Politicians have tried to have it banned.
lore.epic: Burst from a royal waistcoat with the force of a cannonball. The wedding cake survived, but the best man's speech did not.
lore.legendary: Held an entire circus tent by one ancient thread through the storm of a century. When he finally let go, the tent took flight and founded its own kingdom.

names.legendary: Bagthera, Guardian of the Unseen Shot

lore.common: Turns a comfortable strap into a medieval shoulder-punishment device after ten minutes.
lore.uncommon: Hides the lens cap in a pocket that definitely did not exist yesterday.
lore.rare: Has thirty padded compartments and puts every memory card in the wrong one. Calls it an expedition.
lore.epic: Unzipped its jaws on safari and unleashed an army of stolen cameras. The monkeys immediately founded a photography agency.
lore.legendary: Bagthera guards the cameras of explorers who never returned. Every empty compartment holds the picture they would have taken, and some pictures are still moving.

names.legendary: Baron Lockpenny, Keeper of Lost Gold

lore.common: Rattles with enough coins to make a thief curious. Contains mostly washers.
lore.uncommon: Hides its own key beneath the very table everyone has searched twice.
lore.rare: Can count a room's coins by listening to their jingles. It charges for the service.
lore.epic: Refused to open at the village raffle unless a goat won the grand prize. The goat is now the treasurer.
lore.legendary: Lockpenny has guarded treasures from a hundred ruined kingdoms. Every chest is overflowing, yet he still refuses to refund a fifty-cent deposit.

names.legendary: General Cornelius, Keeper of the Prize

lore.common: Hides its final crumbs in a fold that no human hand can reach.
lore.uncommon: Promises a fantastic toy inside. The toy is a paper ruler, and it is very proud.
lore.rare: Changes the nutrition label every time somebody reads it. Marketing claims it is a feature.
lore.epic: Unleashed a breakfast avalanche across three floors when someone poured too enthusiastically. The milk tanker arrived as emergency support.
lore.legendary: General Cornelius guards the greatest cereal prize never found: a golden spoon granting one perfect breakfast. He has hidden it at the very bottom of every box.

names.legendary: Dame Talisandra, Collector of Destinies

lore.common: Jangles during every attempt to be subtle. Has ruined three surprise parties and one bank robbery.
lore.uncommon: Adds a tiny charm for every awkward memory. The little toilet-shaped one has never been explained.
lore.rare: Steals good luck from anyone who compliments it. Their keys vanish while its owner's parking space appears.
lore.epic: Shook its wrist and released a hundred enchanted trinkets into a wedding. The bride caught the bouquet, the groom caught a miniature tractor.
lore.legendary: Talisandra wears a charm for every fate she has stolen. One is shaped like the Moon; nobody has noticed it has been missing since Tuesday.

names.legendary: Don Cedrigo, Keeper of Forgotten Things

lore.common: Creaks open with the confidence of a haunted mansion, then reveals crayons.
lore.uncommon: Smells so strongly of old cedar that even the moths feel overdressed.
lore.rare: Hides an important letter beneath a pile of marbles. The family has been looking for it since 1987.
lore.epic: Opened its dusty lid and released a parade of childhood treasures across the town hall. The mayor found his missing toy dinosaur and cancelled three meetings.
lore.legendary: Don Cedrigo guards the tiny belongings of people who grew old and forgot them. Every object tells its own story, except the mysterious third house key, which refuses all questions.

names.legendary: Madame Clutchella, Queen of the Gala

lore.common: Holds one lipstick, one key and approximately twelve times too much attitude.
lore.uncommon: Snaps shut at the exact moment the theatre goes silent. The soprano has filed a complaint.
lore.rare: Can hide a full evening's scandals inside a bag smaller than a sandwich.
lore.epic: Released a blinding storm of sequins across the royal ball. Every spy forgot their mission and started posing for photographs.
lore.legendary: Madame Clutchella carries an invitation to every party that ever was. Open her clasp at midnight and you may enter one, but she chooses your outfit and has very questionable taste.

names.legendary: Parasolina, Queen of the Smallest Storm

lore.common: Opens proudly above one ice cube. The cube has no opinion on the weather.
lore.uncommon: Stabs every fruit garnish on the rim and declares it a protected island.
lore.rare: Can summon a cool breeze from a single tropical paper fold. The barflies queue beneath it.
lore.epic: Expanded across the entire resort as a rainbow canopy. The beach umbrellas resigned and went on holiday.
lore.legendary: Parasolina once shielded the last drop of summer from a thousand years of winter. She keeps it hidden beneath her tiny parasol, beside a very smug cocktail cherry.

names.legendary: Aurelius Flip, Judge of Impossible Odds

lore.common: Rolls beneath the vending machine after being told it's the exact change.
lore.uncommon: Lands on its edge whenever a serious decision depends on heads or tails. Enjoys prolonged arguments.
lore.rare: Can grant a wish when thrown into a fountain, but charges interest in embarrassing coincidences.
lore.epic: Spun above the stadium for an entire week before landing. Both teams claimed they had won the toss and played the match anyway.
lore.legendary: Aurelius Flip has settled the fates of kings since the first coin was minted. Every toss is fair, except the one time he landed sideways and accidentally invented a new kingdom.

names.legendary: Granny Kisslock, Keeper of Pennies

lore.common: Bites the fingertips of anyone reaching for exact change. Calls it a transaction fee.
lore.uncommon: Jingles so loudly in the supermarket that shopkeepers start opening tills in anticipation.
lore.rare: Makes every coin in its belly jump into the wrong compartment. The queue behind you grows philosophical.
lore.epic: Snapped shut around a pickpocket's wrist at the royal bazaar. The thief had to pay his ransom in ice creams for every witness.
lore.legendary: Granny Kisslock has guarded the same six pennies for a hundred years, turning away kings and collectors alike. She will open only to buy a grandchild something completely unnecessary.

names.legendary: The Seven Sovereigns of the Sofa Deep

lore.common: Add up to one cent less than the price of whatever you want. Every single time.
lore.uncommon: Form a tall shiny stack that collapses the moment anyone says don't touch it.
lore.rare: Multiply into exact change whenever you win, then transform into foreign coins when the cashier looks. They call this investment.
lore.epic: Burst from a forgotten piggy bank like a river of silver. Three housecats surfed the wave and demanded commission.
lore.legendary: Beneath every sofa lies a secret treasury ruled by seven ancient coins. They have bought and sold entire kingdoms but still cannot agree who owes the delivery driver a tip.

names.legendary: Lady Mirrabelle, Seer of the Seven Faces

lore.common: Snaps shut on your nose the moment you lean in for a closer look.
lore.uncommon: Shows every blemish in terrifying detail but hides the parsley in your teeth.
lore.rare: Reflects the expression you will make five minutes from now. Sometimes it is very concerning.
lore.epic: Flashed sunlight across an entire city until every statue seemed to wink at its own reflection. The pigeons declared it witchcraft.
lore.legendary: Lady Mirrabelle holds seven reflections, each showing the face you might have worn in another life. The seventh is always looking back a second too early.

names.legendary: Glaciobox, Keeper of the Last Summer

lore.common: Locks its lid shut whenever the sandwiches are urgently needed.
lore.uncommon: Freezes the bread but somehow melts every ice lolly.
lore.rare: Keeps an iceberg under the picnic blanket and charges the ants entry.
lore.epic: Opened at a beach barbecue and turned the entire coastline into a ski resort. The lifeguards adapted surprisingly quickly.
lore.legendary: Preserves a snowflake from the first winter in history. Opening its lid on the summer solstice causes every sunbather to remember gloves.

names.legendary: Polar Pete, the Rolling Ice Age

lore.common: Squeaks its wheels all the way across the campsite. Nobody gets to sleep in.
lore.uncommon: Drinks up all the ice before anyone arrives. Still expects applause.
lore.rare: Can cool a hot drink by glaring at it; unfortunately it also glares at people's knees.
lore.epic: Escaped down a hill at a festival and froze the lake into a perfect skating rink. The ducks started charging admission.
lore.legendary: Once carried the last cold drink through an endless desert. Entire kingdoms offered gold; Polar Pete demanded a decent bottle opener.

names.legendary: Lord Claspwick, Last of the Lost Pair

lore.common: Goes missing precisely when the wedding photographer calls everyone together.
lore.uncommon: Insists the wrong sleeve looks better and refuses to swap.
lore.rare: Can fasten any cuff, even the sleeve of a statue or a suit of armour.
lore.epic: Slipped off during the royal waltz and returned as a medal on the rival ambassador's chest. War was narrowly avoided.
lore.legendary: Searched a hundred years for its missing twin, following whispers through ballrooms and tombs. Found it behind the first dresser it ever inspected.

names.legendary: Geminar, the Two That Rule as One

lore.common: One always disappears while the other loudly insists it knows nothing.
lore.uncommon: Swap colours at the church door. Guests assume it's avant-garde.
lore.rare: Fasten two rival politicians' sleeves together until they agree on a budget.
lore.epic: Held an entire royal procession together by accidentally linking every ceremonial coat. Nobody dared stop marching.
lore.legendary: The twin gems once held the sleeves of two warring kings together until peace was signed. They still refuse to separate, even for dry cleaning.

names.legendary: Postmorax, Courier of the Impossible

lore.common: Arrives five minutes after you step into the shower. Every time.
lore.uncommon: Contains one pen surrounded by enough packaging to build a small garage.
lore.rare: Teleports between wrong addresses until the entire street knows your name.
lore.epic: Delivered the royal crown to a goat farm and the goat feed to the palace. Both parties claimed the arrangement was an improvement.
lore.legendary: Has carried gifts across oceans, ages and impossible distances. Postmorax delivers every package eventually, though its tracking page only ever says Out for delivery.

names.legendary: Bagthor, Keeper of All Forgotten Things

lore.common: Contains seven spare outfits and not a single clean wipe.
lore.uncommon: Swallows the house keys whenever the baby begins crying.
lore.rare: Produces an emergency bottle, three socks and a toy giraffe from a pocket nobody knew existed.
lore.epic: Unpacked its contents across the entire zoo. A penguin left wearing a tiny nappy and the keepers were too impressed to intervene.
lore.legendary: Accompanied a legendary parent on a journey through seven kingdoms, producing everything needed before anyone asked. The only thing Bagthor could not provide was sleep.

names.legendary: Saint Clink, Keeper of the Last Coin

lore.common: Swallows coins with enormous enthusiasm. Has no idea what they are worth.
lore.uncommon: Shakes itself at passersby and pretends to be an extremely small maraca.
lore.rare: Every coin donated turns into a loaf of bread for somebody who needs one. The baker is suspicious.
lore.epic: Rolled through the royal treasury, collecting every forgotten penny. By morning it had built a school and an alarming amount of paperwork.
lore.legendary: Saint Clink keeps the final coin from every fallen kingdom. Whenever someone gives without expecting anything back, another forgotten village gets a second chance.

names.legendary: Duffelgrim, Keeper of Seven Journeys

lore.common: Has a black hole at the bottom where clean socks go to disappear.
lore.uncommon: Swallows the gym kit and releases a smell that could clear a bus.
lore.rare: Can contain an entire month's luggage but refuses to give back the toothbrush.
lore.epic: Rolled off the airport carousel carrying six strangers' holidays and one unamused customs officer. All seven destinations changed overnight.
lore.legendary: Duffelgrim once traveled every road of the old empire on the shoulder of a nameless wanderer. Its hidden pocket still contains the roads that were erased from maps.

names.legendary: Pearlith, Jewel of the Moonlit Ear

lore.common: Loses its tiny backing during the first dance. Every time.
lore.uncommon: Dangles so close to the wearer's shoulder it insists on choosing the outfit.
lore.rare: Can steal a reflection from any mirror and wear it as a glittering gem.
lore.epic: Caught every light from the royal ballroom in its dangling crystals, leaving the chandeliers dark and the dancers sparkling.
lore.legendary: Pearlith was fashioned from a moonbeam caught in a pearl. Whoever wears it hears the songs of the ocean, even a hundred leagues inland.

names.legendary: Ovoria, Mother of the Unhatched

lore.common: Has twelve tiny beds and counts thirteen residents every night.
lore.uncommon: Hides the cracked egg beneath an innocent-looking label.
lore.rare: Can cushion an egg falling from the roof. Immediately demands an insurance payout.
lore.epic: Defended a dozen eggs from a runaway shopping trolley by transforming into a cardboard castle. The supermarket staff now salute it.
lore.legendary: Ovoria guarded the final clutch of golden eggs through a winter that lasted seven years. On the eighth spring, twelve phoenix chicks broke their shells at once.

names.legendary: Madame Kohlette, Queen of the Sharp Line

lore.common: Promises two matching wings. Delivers one wing and an interesting question mark.
lore.uncommon: Likes drawing whiskers on people who fall asleep at parties.
lore.rare: Its perfectly sharp wing can slice a sheet of paper. The art teacher has confiscated it.
lore.epic: Drew wings on the entire theatre cast. At the curtain call they rose into the rafters and demanded to be paid as birds.
lore.legendary: Kohlette once drew a black line across the horizon and divided day from night. The moon wears her signature cat-eye look whenever it goes out.

names.legendary: Baron Bumford of the Hidden Treasury

lore.common: Holds two coins, a bus ticket and the confidence to visit six museums.
lore.uncommon: Rides up to the ribs whenever its owner runs, then claims to be a chest bag.
lore.rare: Produces forgotten sweets from a holiday ten years ago. The sweets are somehow fresh.
lore.epic: Burst open during the city marathon and unleashed a wave of jelly babies. The runners abandoned their records to rescue the little red ones.
lore.legendary: Bumford carried the lost crown jewels unnoticed through every airport in Europe. Customs searched the suitcase, the hat and the socks; nobody suspected the neon waist pouch.

names.legendary: Tokenius, Emperor of the Last Square

lore.common: Hops onto the wrong square when nobody is looking.
lore.uncommon: Cheats one square forward whenever nobody is looking. Says it was the dice.
lore.rare: Moves across the board without being touched and insists the house has a ghost.
lore.epic: Took command of every game piece in the cupboard. By morning the kitchen was divided into kingdoms and the biscuits were under siege.
lore.legendary: Tokenius has won every board game ever invented. His weakness is a six-sided die that always lands on the floor and rolls under the sofa.

names.legendary: Lady Giftoria of the Thousand Returns

lore.common: Has so much tissue paper inside that the present gets lost.
lore.uncommon: Has more tissue paper than gift. The recipient is still searching for the present.
lore.rare: Travels from one birthday to another without anyone carrying it. Every year a new family finds it full of somebody else's candles.
lore.epic: Bursting with mysterious party gifts, it escaped the celebration and scattered sweets through the streets. The children renamed the holiday.
lore.legendary: Giftoria has passed between generations without ever being thrown away. Each new owner discovers one tiny surprise left by someone who loved them long ago.

names.legendary: Pandora Parcel, the Unending Surprise

lore.common: Ties its ribbon in a knot so tight that you have to wait ages to open it.
lore.uncommon: Tightens its ribbon the moment someone reaches for the scissors.
lore.rare: Whispers what is inside, but always lies. Once convinced a child there was a pony in a matchbox.
lore.epic: Exploded open at the royal birthday and filled the palace with miniature gift boxes. The guests are still unwrapping their shoes.
lore.legendary: Nobody has opened the innermost box of Pandora Parcel. The last explorer returned after seven years with a tiny crown and a very apologetic note.

names.legendary: Umbrellion, the Greenhouse of Storms

lore.common: Gets wedged in every doorway because it's too wide to fit through.
lore.uncommon: Is too wide for doorways and insists the doorway is being unreasonable.
lore.rare: Steers rain away from one green and sends every drop into the neighbouring sand trap. The greenkeeper has requested a ceasefire.
lore.epic: Lifted an entire foursome over the water hazard during a gale. The scorecards count it as one stroke.
lore.legendary: Umbrellion once sheltered a whole village from the rain beneath one enormous canopy. When the storm passed, the village discovered an entire golf course had grown underneath.

names.legendary: Carryall, the Hundred-Trip Hero

lore.common: Digs its handles into your fingers exactly two minutes before you get home.
lore.uncommon: Holds five cartons of milk with a heroic expression, then splits its bottom at the doorstep.
lore.rare: Grows heavier whenever someone says it is only a short walk. Nobody says it anymore.
lore.epic: Burst on the bus and sent a hundred onions rolling down the aisle. Every passenger arrived at work crying.
lore.legendary: Carryall once hauled a village's winter supplies across a frozen pass. Every spring the grateful villagers leave it one perfectly ripe pear.

names.legendary: Coach Funk, Keeper of Forgotten Kits

lore.common: Smells like yesterday's gym class and makes the bus change seats around it.
lore.uncommon: Has a separate pocket for shoes, but refuses to keep the smell in that pocket.
lore.rare: Produces the exact missing PE kit before an exam, except every sock belongs to a different child.
lore.epic: Burst open after the school tournament and released a cloud so powerful the rival team surrendered from across the playground.
lore.legendary: Coach Funk has collected every lost gym sock since the first sports day. A secret stadium is rumoured to exist inside his bag, but nobody has volunteered to look.

names.legendary: Old Frostlid, Guardian of the Last Catch

lore.common: Leaves a puddle in the car boot and denies knowing anything about it.
lore.uncommon: Guards the picnic sandwiches with all the seriousness of a sea captain.
lore.rare: Keeps its catch frozen through the hottest afternoon, even when the fishing boat forgets the shade.
lore.epic: Opened its lid at the fish market and froze every puddle into tiny skating rinks. The seagulls discovered ice hockey.
lore.legendary: Old Frostlid carried the final catch through a storm that lasted an entire winter. When the fishermen returned at spring tide, their fish still wore a silver coat of frost.

names.legendary: Lady Velvetlid, Guardian of Stolen Stars

lore.common: Keeps only one earring from every pair. Nobody knows where the other halves go.
lore.uncommon: Winds its tiny ballerina until she performs the same dance with visible annoyance.
lore.rare: Knots all the necklaces together into a glittering puzzle that rearranges itself each night.
lore.epic: Released its music-box ballerina during a thunderstorm, and she danced through every jeweller's window in town. The diamonds applauded.
lore.legendary: Lady Velvetlid holds a necklace strung with the stars that once guided a lost princess home. At midnight her tiny ballerina dances the route across the velvet lining.

names.legendary: Remembria, the Box of Unforgotten Days

lore.common: Keeps one cinema ticket, three buttons and a photograph of somebody's elbow. All are precious.
lore.uncommon: Refuses to throw away anything with even a slightly sentimental story.
lore.rare: Makes an old photograph whisper the laughter heard on the day it was taken.
lore.epic: Opened during a house move and sent a hundred forgotten memories drifting through the rooms like paper butterflies. Nobody packed a box for hours.
lore.legendary: Remembria holds the last happy memory of everyone who has ever called the house home. When the family gathers, it opens by itself and lets the old stories shine again.

names.legendary: Sir Briefsworth, Shield of the Last File

lore.common: Carries the laptop safely but leaves the charger on the kitchen table on purpose.
lore.uncommon: Has six padded compartments and hides the laptop in the seventh, imaginary one.
lore.rare: Slips off its owner's shoulder at precisely the moment the train doors open.
lore.epic: Spilled three cables, a banana and the world's most important presentation across the station escalator. The screens now run the banana's slideshow.
lore.legendary: Sir Briefsworth crossed a kingdom in a storm with the only copy of a forgotten inventor's plans. Every document survived dry; the knight himself emerged smelling of wet sandwich.

names.legendary: Lady Balmsworth, Tamer of the Frost

lore.common: Drops its cap into the darkest corner of the bathroom and waits for someone to look for it.
lore.uncommon: Melts in a trouser pocket on the first warm day of spring.
lore.rare: Leaves a cherry-scented trail that the family dog follows through the entire house.
lore.epic: Melted inside the school-trip coach and filled every seat with the scent of strawberries. The driver swore they were travelling through a giant jam sandwich.
lore.legendary: Lady Balmsworth once soothed the cracked lips of the winter wind itself. Since then, every first breeze of spring has carried a faint cherry scent across the frozen hills.

names.legendary: Madame Rubella, the Scarlet Signature

lore.common: Practises its smile on the bathroom mirror, then leaves evidence on the toothpaste cap.
lore.uncommon: Kisses every teacup at the party and denies knowing any of them.
lore.rare: Paints lips on every portrait in the gallery overnight. Even the stern admirals look pleased.
lore.epic: Signed the mayor's forehead in permanent crimson before the election debate. His campaign posters have never looked happier.
lore.legendary: Madame Rubella kissed a marble statue awake at midnight. It now wanders the museums asking for a matching handbag.

names.legendary: Aurelia, the Heart That Remembers

lore.common: Snaps shut whenever someone leans over to see the tiny picture inside.
lore.uncommon: Keeps the photograph of a childhood dog perfectly warm, even on the coldest mornings.
lore.rare: Opens to show a different beloved face to each person who holds it. Nobody wants to put it down.
lore.epic: At the family reunion, its portrait began speaking and settled a hundred-year argument about who stole the wedding cake.
lore.legendary: Aurelia held a farewell kiss for three generations, never fading. When its final wearer opened it beside the sea, every ship's bell rang once for the person in the picture.

names.legendary: Lady Lunchetta, Keeper of Recess

lore.common: Flattens sandwiches into modern art between the school gate and the classroom.
lore.uncommon: Keeps yoghurt cold but makes the banana smell suspiciously like cheese.
lore.rare: Smuggles an extra biscuit into every lunch, then swears it knows nothing about it.
lore.epic: Opened on the school bus and released a flock of crisps that took over the driver's seat. Everyone arrived at the zoo smelling of salt and vinegar.
lore.legendary: Lady Lunchetta has packed a warm lunch for every child lost in a snowstorm. When the last child came home, only a trail of tiny sandwich crusts marked her route.

names.legendary: Captain Crustlock of the Golden Sandwich

lore.common: Snaps its lid closed just before you finish packing the apple.
lore.uncommon: Leaks one perfectly aimed drop of juice onto the sandwich every day.
lore.rare: Refuses to open until someone has eaten the vegetables. Bribes involving chocolate do not work.
lore.epic: Escaped the school coach and rolled down the aisle opening every other lunch box. The children declared an unexpected buffet holiday.
lore.legendary: Captain Crustlock once preserved the last sandwich through forty winters. When the starving expedition finally opened the box, it was still warm and had packed itself a napkin.

names.legendary: Countess Glampouch, the Endless Vanity

lore.common: Opens with a little sigh and exhales powder onto everything within reach.
lore.uncommon: Packs sixteen brushes, seven lipsticks and somehow still loses the only mirror.
lore.rare: Rearranges its contents overnight, placing the glitter where the foundation should be.
lore.epic: Burst open backstage and painted every actor, prop and startled stagehand in matching pink. The tragedy became a musical.
lore.legendary: Countess Glampouch dressed an entire royal court for the masquerade of a hundred mirrors. At dawn no one could tell which guests were people and which were reflections.

names.legendary: Madame Noctilash, the Unblinking Star

lore.common: Leaves a tiny black smudge under one eye just before the family photograph.
lore.uncommon: Combines three lashes into one enormous dramatic antenna.
lore.rare: Grows its wearer's eyelashes long enough to sweep the dust from the dressing table.
lore.epic: Turned the entire wedding party into panda-eyed mourners during the speeches. The bride laughed hardest and ruined everyone else's makeup.
lore.legendary: Madame Noctilash once painted the eyelashes of the moon so dark that eclipses became fashionable. The stars still blink whenever she closes her wand.

names.legendary: Lord Tinderwell of the Final Spark

lore.common: Rattles indignantly whenever someone checks whether there are any matches left.
lore.uncommon: Slides its tray out from the wrong end and scatters the contents into a pocket.
lore.rare: Guards its rough striker strip like a castle drawbridge, letting only a careful grown-up through.
lore.epic: Opened its tiny drawer to reveal an entire model village, complete with a mayor demanding a proper-sized matchbox.
lore.legendary: Lord Tinderwell sheltered the final unlit match during an age without dawn. He never opened his drawer until the day the people were ready to carry light again.

names.legendary: The Crimson Order of the Last Lantern

lore.common: Rattle at the top of the cupboard where only grown-ups can reach them.
lore.uncommon: Refuse to light when their tips are wet and sulk together in the box.
lore.rare: Form a perfectly straight line when counted, with the last one guarding the rest like a tiny soldier.
lore.epic: Marched out of their carton during the lantern festival and relit every guttered candle before retreating safely into their box.
lore.legendary: The Crimson Order has kept a thousand lanterns lit through the stormiest nights, one flame at a time. Their last member has never been struck.

names.legendary: Satchelor, Rider of the Unsent Letter

lore.common: Smacks its owner's hip with every step and acts surprised by the complaint.
lore.uncommon: Carries a notebook, two chargers and a biscuit that has lost its original shape.
lore.rare: Delivers a secret note through the city before its writer has finished signing it.
lore.epic: Opened on a racing bicycle and sent a hundred letters fluttering into exactly the wrong doorways. The neighbourhood made unexpected pen pals.
lore.legendary: Satchelor once crossed a city asleep beneath snow to deliver a letter never posted. When its recipient opened the envelope, the sender's voice returned for one last conversation.

names.legendary: Melodia, Keeper of the Last Goodnight

lore.common: Takes a hundred turns of its little key to sing for half a minute. Demands an encore anyway.
lore.uncommon: Starts its tiny tune whenever someone tries to sneak past the nursery door.
lore.rare: Plays the melody of whoever last held it, even if that person has forgotten how the song goes.
lore.epic: Opened its lid at the great concert and hushed a whole orchestra with one delicate tune. The conductor asked whether he could fit inside.
lore.legendary: Melodia guarded the lullabies of a forgotten kingdom in a little wooden box. Each time it opens, a child somewhere dreams of a voice they thought they had lost.

names.legendary: Chromella, Lady of the Painted Stars

lore.common: Looks perfectly dry until someone touches a door handle. Then reveals its true personality.
lore.uncommon: Sprinkles glitter onto every fingertip and quietly onto every piece of furniture.
lore.rare: Changes shade whenever its wearer tells a fib. The party guests started hiding their hands.
lore.epic: Painted the whole ballroom in one sweep of its tiny brush. Even the chandelier wore a sparkling manicure.
lore.legendary: Chromella painted the fingernails of the night sky with ten shades of starlight. On cloudless evenings she checks her work and polishes the dullest constellations.

names.legendary: Madame Varnissa of the Everlasting Shine

lore.common: Glues its own cap shut after every use. It says beauty requires strength.
lore.uncommon: Drips exactly one stubborn spot onto the clean dressing table. That spot never quite disappears.
lore.rare: Pours out a different shade for every mood and refuses to admit its little brush is enchanted.
lore.epic: Fell from a salon shelf and painted the floor in a living rainbow. Customers began walking home with magical footprints.
lore.legendary: Varnissa sealed the colours of a vanished sunset in a tiny glass bottle. One drop makes a faded treasure gleam as it did on the day it was made.

names.legendary: Lady Aurelia, the Unbroken Chain

lore.common: Places its clasp exactly where fingers can never reach without help.
lore.uncommon: Tangles itself with every other piece of jewellery overnight, then claims they were dancing.
lore.rare: Tightens gently around a forgotten family keepsake until its owner remembers why it mattered.
lore.epic: Burst into a thousand pearls across the palace ballroom. Each pearl showed a different memory to whoever caught it, and the dancing stopped for a night.
lore.legendary: Aurelia joined the jewels of seven lost families into one necklace and carried their histories across an age of war. Every stone warms when its rightful heir draws near.

names.legendary: Browncloak, Guardian of the Last Loaf

lore.common: Announces the theft of every secret biscuit with a noise like a furious newspaper.
lore.uncommon: Carries groceries bravely until the first raindrop, then surrenders its entire bottom.
lore.rare: Puffs itself into a paper balloon and bursts at the exact moment a classroom falls silent.
lore.epic: Organised a rebellion of all the takeaway bags in town. They marched down the high street, depositing sandwiches at the feet of confused pedestrians.
lore.legendary: Browncloak hid the final loaf during the winter famine in a humble paper fold. No snow or rain could pierce it until the bread reached the village's last hungry child.

names.legendary: Ironroot, Weight of the Four Winds

lore.common: Catches every bare toe that walks past the patio table and calls it greeting.
lore.uncommon: Leaks a tiny beach of sand beneath itself by the end of summer.
lore.rare: Holds a giant parasol steady while a storm steals the furniture around it.
lore.epic: Refused to budge during the garden wedding, forcing the ceremony, the buffet and the musicians to circle around it. The guests called it tradition.
lore.legendary: Ironroot anchored the last shade tree of a desert village while four fierce winds tore at the earth. Travellers still find cool shelter wherever his iron foot rests.

names.legendary: Sir Cardboard, Master of Lost Addresses

lore.common: Waits in front of the doorway so nobody can get their groceries inside.
lore.uncommon: Wears enough packing tape to survive an underwater expedition. The scissors are terrified.
lore.rare: Lands precisely on its weakest corner during every delivery and blames the driver's shoes.
lore.epic: Rolled off the courier van and found its way through six streets to the correct door, collecting twelve stickers and a stray cat.
lore.legendary: Sir Cardboard travelled around the world carrying a letter whose address had faded. He returned on the sender's birthday, battered but still protecting the reply inside.

names.legendary: Canopius, Guardian of the Summer Court

lore.common: Takes thirty turns of its handle to open and only two to close at the wrong moment.
lore.uncommon: Rotates its shade away from whoever has just applied sun cream.
lore.rare: Holds back a rainstorm above the picnic table while letting exactly one drop land in the salad.
lore.epic: Caught a sudden gust at the garden barbecue and sailed over four fences with the sausages still sizzling beneath it. The neighbours hosted the rest of dinner.
lore.legendary: Canopius spread his great canopy above the drought-stricken gardens of an ancient city. Not a single leaf scorched beneath his shade until the rain finally returned.

names.legendary: Lady Gemoria, Keeper of Unspoken Vows

lore.common: Slips behind its wearer's neck just when someone compliments the jewel.
lore.uncommon: Opens its clasp during boring speeches and slides off to find a better party.
lore.rare: Glows softly whenever someone nearby is hiding a secret crush. The school dance became unbearable.
lore.epic: Swung from the ballroom chandelier and scattered constellations across the floor. The dancers spent all night waltzing between stars.
lore.legendary: Lady Gemoria carries the final promise of a vanished kingdom inside her stone. Once each century it shines, and two lost lovers somehow find their way home.

names.legendary: Old Briarwick, Keeper of the Blue Moon

lore.common: Lives in Grandad's old coat pocket and smells like a forgotten fireside story.
lore.uncommon: Makes soap bubbles instead of smoke whenever a child asks for a demonstration.
lore.rare: Blows a bubble that carries whispered secrets across the garden. The neighbour's cat has become a terrific gossip.
lore.epic: Filled the manor with drifting smoke rings shaped like old family portraits. The actual portraits looked distinctly offended.
lore.legendary: Old Briarwick puffed a silver-blue ring above the last gathering of a vanished family. The ring still circles their empty home on every midsummer night.

names.legendary: Boxaroni, Guardian of the Last Hot Slice

lore.common: Leaves a perfect oily square on the table and pretends somebody else sat there.
lore.uncommon: Pops its lid open whenever a delivery driver runs for the door.
lore.rare: Keeps pizza hot across impossible distances. The cheese was still bubbling after a train trip through a snowstorm.
lore.epic: Escaped the takeaway shop and delivered a hundred dinners to hungry strangers before anyone had ordered. The chef demanded to know where the pizzas came from.
lore.legendary: Boxaroni delivered a hot slice every midnight to an empty castle for three centuries. On the last night the ghosts finally opened the gates and remembered to leave a tip.

names.legendary: Tupperina, Keeper of the Lost Lids

lore.common: Has seven lids in the cupboard and not one that actually fits.
lore.uncommon: Turns orange after meeting tomato sauce and considers the colour a permanent souvenir.
lore.rare: Stores leftovers so well that their smell disappears completely. The suspicious broccoli is still hiding inside.
lore.epic: Stacked itself into an impregnable fortress in the refrigerator. The cheese staged a siege but could not find a matching lid.
lore.legendary: Tupperina kept the lost lunch of a king sealed for four hundred years. When archaeologists finally opened the lid, the sandwich was fresh and the note still read DON'T TOUCH.

names.legendary: Chipmancer, Dealer of the Last Wager

lore.common: Makes satisfying clacks until someone drops the whole stack beneath the table.
lore.uncommon: Rolls into a stranger's pile whenever its owner starts bragging.
lore.rare: Changes colour when a player tries to bluff, ruining the world's shortest poker career.
lore.epic: Stacked itself into a tower so tall that the casino ceiling had to be raised. The manager called it a structural win.
lore.legendary: Chipmancer once wagered a single wooden token against a king's entire treasury. By dawn the king was laughing, the beggar was rich, and nobody remembered which way the chip had landed.

names.legendary: Aurelia, Circle of the Unbroken Promise

lore.common: Slips off in the sink and waits beside the drain with a wicked little grin.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a green mark on the finger and insists it is an exclusive enchantment.
lore.rare: Glows whenever somebody breaks a promise, which makes wedding rehearsals terribly awkward.
lore.epic: Summoned every lost ring in the city to a glittering reunion. The sewers sparkled for a week afterward.
lore.legendary: Aurelia sealed a promise between two kingdoms in gold. When the king broke it, the ring tightened around his crown and refused to come off until he apologised.

names.legendary: Madame Spangle, Star-Seamstress

lore.common: Escapes from a party dress and turns up on the dog's nose six months later.
lore.uncommon: Sticks to one cheek at the office and refuses to leave until someone compliments the outfit.
lore.rare: Steals one glint from every spotlight and hides them in a tiny sparkling cloak.
lore.epic: Shed its coat across a concert hall, turning the entire audience into walking mirror balls. The lighting crew resigned and went dancing.
lore.legendary: Madame Spangle stole the last sparkle from a dying star and stitched it into a ballroom gown. On dark nights, entire constellations gather to watch her twirl.

names.legendary: Madame Mender of the Last Button

lore.common: Swallows the one button you need and offers seven unmatched blue ones instead.
lore.uncommon: Gives every needle its own little bedroom and leaves the scissors sleeping outside.
lore.rare: Can pull a missing button from any coat in the city, though its replacement always has a tiny smiling face.
lore.epic: Released a lifetime's worth of tangled threads at once. The school play emerged from backstage as one enormous knitted dragon.
lore.legendary: Madame Mender stores the last button from every vanished uniform. When soldiers returned from a forgotten war, she matched each coat to its owner and made their families whole again.

names.legendary: Boxwell, Architect of Little Kingdoms

lore.common: Rattles suspiciously in the wardrobe even though the new shoes are long gone.
lore.uncommon: Offers a mountain of tissue paper instead of the trainers everyone was looking for.
lore.rare: Opens onto a miniature room where a lost toy keeps all the missing marbles.
lore.epic: Constructed an entire shoebox city in the attic. The hamster residents declared independence and demanded proper staircases.
lore.legendary: Boxwell built a refuge for every forgotten childhood treasure inside a single cardboard lid. Turn it over and a hundred tiny windows light up with memories no one meant to throw away.

names.legendary: Circadia, Who Counted Every Star

lore.common: Buzzes on its owner's finger whenever they try to ignore a message.
lore.uncommon: Awards a fitness achievement for waving at the cat and refuses to take it back.
lore.rare: Detects its wearer's tiredness before they feel it and gently dims every light in the room.
lore.epic: Counted the dancing feet at a festival as a marathon and summoned a finish line across the stage. The drummer won by accident.
lore.legendary: Circadia was worn by a traveller who tried to count every heartbeat beneath the night sky. She still records the quiet pulses of the world, reminding even the busiest kings that rest is part of the journey.

names.legendary: Boxalor, Vault of the Unlived Summers

lore.common: Swallows one Christmas decoration every year and claims it never saw it.
lore.uncommon: Has a sticky lid that refuses to open unless the contents are thoroughly embarrassing.
lore.rare: Swaps winter scarves for summer beach towels every time the attic door is locked.
lore.epic: Unfolded into a vast maze of stacked boxes during the annual clear-out. The family found a room labelled 'Things We Meant to Fix'.
lore.legendary: Boxalor holds the toys of children long since grown old. Once a year it opens its lid, and the house remembers the laughter that once filled it.

names.legendary: Parasolus, Shield of the Burning Road

lore.common: Explodes into an enormous circle the moment someone tries to fold it.
lore.uncommon: Sticks to the windscreen with such determination that the suction cups leave tiny battle scars.
lore.rare: Keeps the car cool while the vehicle beside it turns into a miniature sauna.
lore.epic: Burst open in a car park and vaulted over the traffic, shading an entire motorway service station from the noon sun.
lore.legendary: Parasolus travelled the burning desert on the back of an abandoned car, casting a moving refuge for every creature that followed its silver reflection.

names.legendary: Barblock, Lord of Lost Hooks

lore.common: Opens at the wrong angle and presents a fishhook to the nearest unsuspecting thumb.
lore.uncommon: Hides a wriggling bait worm beneath the expensive lures to frighten anglers.
lore.rare: Summons every discarded fishing float from the river to form a bobbing defensive wall.
lore.epic: Burst open during a fishing contest and sent an army of enchanted lures swimming off to catch the fish themselves.
lore.legendary: Captain Barblock collected a century's worth of lost hooks from the riverbed, melting them into a silver key that opened the drowned fisherman's chest.

names.legendary: Tintrix, the Vault of Unbaked Secrets

lore.common: Bites fingers whenever someone tries to get the last biscuit.
lore.uncommon: Pretends to hold shortbread and reveals thirty-seven needles and a suspicious button.
lore.rare: Rattles with a different lost object each time it is shaken; nobody can find the key inside.
lore.epic: Escaped the pantry and enlisted every tin in town into an armoured biscuit rebellion. The biscuit factory surrendered before teatime.
lore.legendary: Tintrix preserves the first recipe ever baked, hidden beneath a thousand false bottoms. Those who open the last lid find a handwritten instruction: share.

names.legendary: Achoomara, Mother of the Endless Tissue

lore.common: Offers one tissue and sneaks four more into your sleeve.
lore.uncommon: Grows another paper head every time someone pulls one out. The desk is becoming crowded.
lore.rare: Hears a sneeze through three walls and launches a tissue into the air with uncanny accuracy.
lore.epic: Unleashed an indoor snowstorm of tissues at the school flu clinic, burying the headteacher beneath a very soft drift.
lore.legendary: Achoomara once caught the first sneeze of winter before it reached a sleeping baby. She has filled a secret paper kingdom beneath the world's pillows ever since.

names.legendary: Sir Scrubscase of the Lost Hotel

lore.common: Leaks shampoo onto the only clean shirt in your suitcase.
lore.uncommon: Hides the toothbrush in a secret compartment and laughs at morning breath.
lore.rare: Swallows hotel soap bars by the dozen and spits out little mint-scented treasure maps.
lore.epic: Unzipped during a flight and unleashed a stampede of shampoo bottles down the aisle. The pilot requested conditioner.
lore.legendary: Sir Scrubscase vanished at a seaside hotel and returned after twelve years stuffed with soaps from sixty kingdoms. Every miniature bottle contained a map to somewhere impossible.

names.legendary: Grommetus, the Bag of Ten Thousand Fixes

lore.common: Jangles up the stairs so everyone knows the plumber has arrived.
lore.uncommon: Hides the correct screwdriver under a mountain of perfectly useless ones.
lore.rare: Swallows broken tools and spits out stranger, slightly improved versions after midnight.
lore.epic: Unzipped on a construction site and deployed a whole mechanical workshop, complete with tiny foremen arguing over a single bolt.
lore.legendary: Grommetus accompanied the first builder who dared repair a fallen star. He carries every tool that has ever been lost, but will lend one only to someone willing to mend a stranger's home.

names.legendary: Tuppernox, the Box That Held a Summer

lore.common: Burps when its lid is pushed down and insists everyone else is being rude.
lore.uncommon: Keeps yesterday's pasta hidden at the back of the fridge until it evolves a small civilisation.
lore.rare: Seals so tightly that the pickles inside begin planning a prison break.
lore.epic: Opened after a decade in the freezer and released an ancient army of perfectly preserved peas that conquered the dinner table.
lore.legendary: Tuppernox sealed away one warm summer afternoon during the longest winter. A hundred years later the lid lifted, and the scent of strawberries returned birdsong to a silent garden.

names.legendary: Aurelia, the Circle That Returns

lore.common: Slips off at the beach and hides behind one grain of sand.
lore.uncommon: Gets stuck after the wedding cake and demands soap and three aunties.
lore.rare: Glimmers whenever two people remember the first time they met.
lore.epic: Rolled away during the vows and led the wedding party on a glorious chase through three gardens and the village pond. The couple laughed all the way.
lore.legendary: Vanished into a field on the day its owner went away to sea. Decades later a new shoot carried the ring above the earth, still shining beside the person who had waited.
